baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative construction اجعلني مقيم الصلاة makes مقيم a conferred identity, not merely a requested action.
baseline_models.mechanism: Divine making installs the speaker in an enduring office: he is to keep the specified worship standing through care, persistence, and performance.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to be on a state supplies the constitutive force of the imperative.
Care, preservation, and sustained oversight make مقيم an office of maintenance.
The specified worship with standing, bowing, and prostration is the practice being maintained.

changed_reading.after: Constitute me as an enduring custodian who keeps the prescribed prayer standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ellipsis in ومن ذريتي carries the requested making into part of the offspring, while ربي becomes ربنا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same divinely conferred prayer-maintaining role is projected into a dispersed future lineage; once offspring enter the request, singular lordship opens into a shared communal invocation.

activation_trace.role: The causative making remains understood across the ellipsis after ومن ذريتي.
Tiny multiplicity and spread give the offspring a distributed, many-member horizon.
Gradual nurture and completion link the singular and plural invocations to formation over generations.
Sustained guardianship is the role elliptically extended from the speaker to offspring.

changed_reading.before: Bless me and my descendants with prayer.
changed_reading.after: Draw from my dispersed offspring a divinely nurtured continuation of the prayer-maintaining role, a lineage able to say our Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah places الصلاة and دعائي in one petition and closes with تقبل.
baseline_models.mechanism: Embodied worship and voiced invocation form a reflexive loop: the speaker uses supplication to ask for continuity in ritual prayer, then asks that this very call be favorably received.

activation_trace.role: The specialized embodied rite supplies the maintained practice.
Prayer as invocation and blessing opens the rite toward spoken petition.
Calling and inclining by speech identify the utterance itself as an addressed act.
Reception with satisfaction turns the uttered call toward consequential uptake.

changed_reading.before: The verse makes two adjacent requests, one about ritual and one about a spoken prayer.
changed_reading.after: The spoken prayer performs what it asks to sustain and seeks reception for the whole self-renewing ritual-call loop.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah distinguishes a call, a response, hearing, and an embodied gift. Because a bad call can receive a response, تقبل دعائي asks for right and effective uptake rather than mere audibility or any answer.

activation_trace.role: Reception with satisfaction anchors the focus request in valid uptake.
Calling by speech is directed toward forgiveness, supplying a divinely aligned call.
The same speech-call image is used for Satan's invitation, showing that a call is not self-validating.
Replying to speech supplies an actual response to a bad call and separates response from valid acceptance.
A gift without exchange supplies an embodied prior answer in the granted sons.
Auditory reception supplies the explicit hearing pole immediately before the focus asks for acceptance.
The preceding discourse is named as addressed supplication, linking prior gift and hearing to the focus call.

structural_cues: 14:10 gives a divine call whose stated direction is forgiveness.
14:22 pairs دعوتكم with فاستجبتم in a misdirected call-response sequence.
14:39 names a granted lineage and a Lord who hears supplication; 14:40 still asks for acceptance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aligned and misaligned calls, response to the latter, and prior hearing embodied as gift; I infer that acceptance means normatively right, durable uptake. A live alternative is the ordinary sense of favorable answer without a stronger hearing-response distinction.

changed_reading.before: Hear my words and grant my request.
changed_reading.after: Receive this call rightly and embody it in the stable formation of speaker and lineage, since hearing or responsiveness alone does not guarantee alignment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus combines a standing-maintenance root with an offspring root that can image scattering. Against works reduced to ash and violently dispersed by wind, established prayer becomes a form that keeps action and lineage from losing all hold.

activation_trace.role: Support, axis, and that by which a thing subsists supply the cohesion side of the mechanism.
Scattering grains or powder exposes a dispersive possibility within the offspring anchor.
Ash left by burning supplies action stripped of durable form.
Wind and moving air supply the carrier of dispersal.
A severe wind that makes things light and scatters them supplies the destructive force.

structural_cues: 14:18 likens works to ash intensified by wind on a stormy day.
The people in 14:18 cannot retain or command anything of what they acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed works as wind-scattered ash and focus branches of subsistence and scattering; I infer a counter-arrow in which maintained prayer gives distributed descendants and actions durable form. A live alternative is that the ash contrast concerns rejected works only and does not characterize lineage.

changed_reading.before: Make prayer regular in my family.
changed_reading.after: Give a dispersible lineage and its deeds a standing form that resists becoming ungraspable ash.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed-root, rising-branch, recurring-yield sequence supplies a generational growth model: the speaker is to be stabilized as the maintained root of practice, offspring carry it outward as branches, and its effects recur as fruit.

activation_trace.role: Preservation and sustained care make prayer the cultivated practice.
Distributed multiplicity lets the offspring occupy the propagating branch side of the model.
The trunked tree supplies the whole rooted generative architecture.
Root and foundation supply the stable originating generation.
Duration and fixity prevent the originating practice from being uprooted.
A high branch emerging from its root supplies offspring continuity without identity collapse.
The yield of tree and crop supplies the practice's recurring effects.
Each proper time supplies recurrent cadence rather than a single harvest.
Divine strengthening supplies the causal force that keeps the word and its bearers stable.

structural_cues: 14:24 explicitly aligns a good word, a good tree, a fixed root, and an elevated branch.
14:25 adds recurring yield by permission of its Lord.
14:27 attributes the stabilization of believers by the stable word to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a word-tree with fixed root, branch, recurring yield, and divine stabilization; I map speaker to cultivated root and offspring to propagated branches because the focus joins divine making, maintenance, and lineage. A live alternative is to keep the tree mechanism restricted to the good word rather than transfer it to prayer.

changed_reading.before: Pass the same religious habit from parent to descendants.
changed_reading.after: Cultivate a divinely stabilized prayer-root whose distinct descendant branches repeatedly bear effects in their own times.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact command to establish prayer is coordinated with releasing provision and bounded by a before after which exchange and intimate aid are unavailable. Establishment is therefore present, enacted stewardship under a deadline, not static possession of a devotional identity.

activation_trace.role: Sustained care and oversight supply the commanded maintenance of prayer.
The specified rite is the same direct lexical object as in the focus.
The going-out of wealth supplies material release coordinated with ritual maintenance.
Temporal precedence supplies the explicit window before the irreversible day.
Favorable acceptance links the temporal branch shift back to the focus petition.

structural_cues: Secret and public spending broaden the field of enactment.
The clause من قبل أن يأتي يوم لا بيع فيه ولا خلال imposes a closing horizon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatical coordination between prayer and spending plus an explicit before; I infer that the prayer-maintaining identity is tested in timely material release and cannot be deferred. A live alternative is that prayer and spending remain parallel duties without one functionally qualifying the other.

changed_reading.before: Make me someone characterized by regular prayer.
changed_reading.after: Make me maintain prayer now as an enacted stewardship that releases provision before the window for exchange and aid closes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Biological sons remain exposed to rival worship, while the next ayah defines being 'of me' through following and leaves disobedience live. The partitive ومن ذريتي therefore reads as hoped-for, divinely formed continuity rather than automatic inherited identity.

activation_trace.role: Distributed offspring supply biological multiplicity without guaranteeing one orientation.
Filiation and descent supply the explicit biological relation placed at risk.
Submissive worship supplies the contested behavior that lineage does not settle.
A worshipped body supplies the rival object from which speaker and sons seek distance.
Allegiance and succession supply the enacted criterion for being 'of me.'
Departure from obedience keeps discontinuity possible inside biological descent.

structural_cues: 14:35 asks that both Abraham and his sons be kept from idol worship.
14:36 says whoever follows me is of me and separately admits the one who disobeys me.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies biological sons, rival worship, and a follow-disobey criterion for belonging; I infer that ومن ذريتي seeks a realized line of practice rather than assuming heredity transmits it. A live alternative is that min is only an ordinary partitive with no contrastive lineage claim.

changed_reading.before: Prayer identity should pass naturally to descendants.
changed_reading.after: Divine making must bring a prayer-maintaining lineage into actuality because biological descent remains vulnerable to rival worship and disobedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Offspring are deliberately settled in an uncultivated valley by a protected house for the stated purpose of establishing prayer; human attraction, fruit, and gratitude then gather around that purpose. Prayer becomes the organizing center of a planted community and its support ecology.

activation_trace.role: Making a home supplies deliberate settlement rather than accidental presence.
Distributed offspring are the population planted into the setting.
Cultivation and growth, explicitly negated in the source phrase, supply the settlement's material lack.
A protected spatial sanctuary supplies the fixed ritual center.
Sustained care supplies the settlement's explicitly stated purpose.
The specified worship is the purpose for which the offspring are settled.
Inclination of desire supplies social attraction toward the settled offspring.
Ripe fruit supplies material support arriving despite the uncultivated site.
Recognition of gift supplies the intended return from the social and material support.

structural_cues: The purpose lām in ليقيموا الصلاة explicitly orders settlement toward prayer.
The sequence moves from barren valley and protected house to attracted hearts, provisioned fruit, and gratitude.
14:37 repeats ذريتي, يقيموا, الصلاة, and ربنا immediately before the focus restates their complex.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies settlement, lack of cultivation, an explicit prayer-purpose, then attraction, fruit, and gratitude; I infer a causal ecology organized around prayer. A live alternative is that the later requests merely secure survival and gratitude alongside, rather than through, the prayer purpose.

changed_reading.before: Prayer is one practice the family should preserve wherever it lives.
changed_reading.after: Prayer is the reason for planting the descendant community there and the center around which sanctuary, attachment, provision, and gratitude cohere.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next petition expands from descendants backward to parents and outward to believers, while the same standing root moves from maintaining prayer to the account standing. The prayer office is embedded in transgenerational solidarity and future answerability.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing guardianship supplies the present standing of prayer.
Covering fault and protecting from its effect supplies the requested relation across the widened group.
Parents by birth extend the lineage axis backward from the focus's offspring.
Trusting assent supplies an affiliation wider than biological family.
The rising of the final accounting supplies the future standing toward which maintained prayer faces.
Counting and reckoning supply the horizon of answerability.

structural_cues: 14:41 immediately continues ربنا and the imperative petition form.
Its beneficiary set is self, parents, and believers, wider than the downward lineage of 14:40.
يقوم الحساب repeats the focus root ق و م in a future accounting construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent widened prayer and a root recurrence from maintaining prayer to the account standing; I infer that present ritual standing prepares a socially extended self for future answerability. A live alternative is that the root recurrence is only lexical and the two standings should remain independent.

changed_reading.before: Maintain prayer as a family inheritance.
changed_reading.after: Maintain prayer within a bond that reaches ancestors and believers and remains answerable when the account itself stands.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from ritual into firecraft through the split صلو/صلي inventory. It remains anchored in الصلاة, the straightness branch of مقيم, and the nearby يَصْلَوْنَهَا occurrence. Downstream prose should render it only as a contrastive material analogy, never as a lexical equation of prayer with burning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الصلاة maps to a branch of heating and straightening a thing, while مقيم carries straightness and the surah later uses صلي for meeting fire.

activation_trace.role: Applying fire to straighten a thing supplies controlled formative exposure as the exploratory image.
Straightness, balance, and rectitude connect the fire-straightening image back to مقيم.
Meeting the heat of fire supplies the destructive, involuntary pole against controlled formation.

changed_reading.before: Established prayer is solely a regularly performed rite.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is a willingly sustained discipline of straightening before the contrasting condition of involuntary exposure to fire.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the midwifery branch of ق ب ل inside a supplication. It remains visibly anchored by تقبل, ذريتي, and the immediately preceding gift of sons in old age. Downstream prose should mark it as a generational receiving analogy, not claim that تقبل lexically means delivering a child here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: تقبل and ذريتي coexist in the focus, allowing the branch image of one who receives the emerging child to refract acceptance.

activation_trace.role: Receiving what emerges into the hand at birth supplies a concrete image of acceptance.
Small, spreading offspring give the receiving image a generational object.
The sons as an unpriced gift supply the immediately prior emergence of lineage.
Advanced age makes the granted lineage a visibly nonautomatic emergence.

changed_reading.before: Approve the words of my supplication.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, receive the emerging prayer-lineage into viability as one receives a birth, rather than merely approving speech.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a dairy branch image for دعاء. It remains anchored in دعائي, descendants, recurring tree-yield, and fruit provision. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for generative continuity, not as the lexical sense of supplication.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: دعائي maps to the small remainder of milk left to call forth what follows, beside the request for prayer among offspring.

activation_trace.role: Milk retained to summon the next flow supplies a generative remainder rather than an exhausted utterance.
Distributed offspring supply the later flow into which the retained call propagates.
Tree and crop yield supply a second image of generative return.
Each proper time makes the return recurrent across intervals.
Ripe fruit supplied to descendants grounds the return in the Abrahamic sequence.

changed_reading.before: The supplication ends once its immediate request is answered.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the accepted call remains as a starter that draws recurring embodied prayer through later descendants.

strongest_changes: The causative request became an appeal for a stable office of maintaining prayer, not occasional performance.
The fixed-root tree and Abrahamic settlement sequences recast that office as selective generational cultivation and the purpose of a community.
The call-response and hearing sequence distinguished valid acceptance from mere audibility or any response.
The command before the closing day and the standing account made establishment present, material, and answerable.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence let the same focus roots change branch and function: ق و م moved among maintenance, rooted stability, and the standing account; ق ب ل moved between acceptance and temporal before; صلو/صلي exposed a contained prayer-fire contrast.
remaining_uncertainties: The tree and settlement mechanisms may illuminate adjacent good-word and Abrahamic material without every causal link transferring to prayer.
The partitive force of ومن ذريتي may be ordinary selection rather than a deliberate contrast between biological and enacted lineage.
The fire-straightening, birth-reception, and generative-remainder readings are branch-grounded analogies but remain too distant to state without explicit qualification.
